title: GPOS Gate Record
description: One quality-gate status for one scope at one subject revision. See core/QUALITY-GATES.md. Per-gate owner and review-policy rules mirror core/registry.json. Cross-record rules (evidence type, context and revision per gate; linked HUMAN_REVIEW existence and verdict; reviewer differs from owner; superseded evidence) are a Phase-2 tooling requirement; the reference implementation lives in tests/validate_framework.py.

revision.description: Exact subject revision (commit, build, asset version) this status applies to. Evidence must match it or be carried over explicitly.

routing_ref.description: task_id of the routing record this gate is the result of. Required for gates of a routed task; the gate must agree with its routing entry.

owner.description: Accountable owner: one of the gate's permitted owners, or HUMAN for HUMAN_REVIEW. game-director and game-engineering never own a gate.

assessed_by.description: Accountable assessor of the status: the owning specialist (AGENT with id = owner) or a human. Automated evidence producers (CI, tools, devices) are evidence sources, never assessors. Required unless status is NOT_RUN.

recorded_by.description: Who wrote this record, e.g. an agent transcribing a human verdict. Not an assessor.

blocking_downgrade_ref.description: Reference to a Human Decision record (schemas/decision.schema.json). A matching pattern is not authority; Phase-2 tooling must resolve it (core/GOVERNANCE.md §12).

cross_review_required.description: Implied true under CROSS_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Under HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, true only when routing or the workflow requires specialist cross-review.

routine_basis.description: For ROUTINE: the routing record and approved authority the bounded work stays inside.

human_review_ref.description: gate_id of the HUMAN_REVIEW record that accepted this scope.

disagreements_disclosed.description: Under HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: the linked review packet exposed every unresolved negative cross-review and a non-PASS specialist assessment.

specialist_assessment.description: Owner's evidence-backed recommendation while the gate awaits review. Not a status.

reviewer.description: A specialist reviewer; game-director never reviews discipline quality. Only reviewers eligible for the gate owner (registry cross_review_eligibility) can contribute to PASS.

superseded.description: True when a later review by the same reviewer replaces this one. Only a superseded negative review counts as resolved.

reviewed_revision.description: Subject revision reviewed. An active (non-superseded) review counts only when it equals scope.revision.

applied_conditions.description: Conditional-evidence conditions that apply to this claim (from routing).

evidence_carryover.description: Evidence from an earlier subject revision that is claimed to remain valid. Each entry must justify why the later change cannot affect the claim. Approval is accountable: owner or authorized human only.

assessed_by.description: Accountable carryover assessor: the gate owner (AGENT with id = owner) or an authorized human. CI, tools and devices may propose, never approve.

proposed_by.description: Optional: who proposed the carryover (may be a tool).

evidence_applicability.description: Evidence whose subject differs from the gate scope, explicitly mapped with justification and approved by the gate owner or an authorized human. Never inferred from matching revisions.

extensions.description: Adapter- or project-specific data. Must not redefine any field above.

id.description: Non-empty identifier without whitespace; used as a cross-record key.
Non-empty identifier without whitespace; used as a cross-record key.
